API Reference

Service — MagmaCache

Injectable cache layer for HTTP requests or any Observable. Results are stored by id and tagged with one or more group names for bulk invalidation. The cache is static (shared across all injector instances).

Methods

Method Signature Description
request <T>(id: string, group: string | string[], observable: Observable<T>, endDate?: Date) => Promise<T> Returns the cached value if available. Otherwise executes the Observable, stores the result and returns it. If endDate is past, the entry is invalidated first.
clearById (id: string) => void Removes a single cached entry by its unique id
clearByGroupName (groupName: string) => void Removes all cached entries that belong to the given group
clearAll () => void Clears the entire cache

Helper — flattenedListItems

Function Signature Description
flattenedListItems (value: string | string[]) => string[] Converts a comma-separated string (e.g. 'Group1, Group2') or an array into a clean string[]. Used to normalize the group parameter of request().
